answers.goal: I want to be a show runner and producer. When I’m not working on my own projects I’m helping produce my friend’s projects.
answers.drew: Bootleg movies! I didn’t grow up with a lot so it was always about cutting corners. My mom would buy me bootlegs from the hair salon and eventually I figured out how to pirate movies online. As I got older I started building my own dvd collection to make up for it lol. A lot of my life I was always focused on looking for ways to make the people around me smile. So I was always performing monologues for my family and I sort of bled into other fields like improv, stand up, music, and screenwriting. I was always a writer even before movies so it felt natural to me to lean into screenwriting for college.
answers.seeking: I’m looking to connect with others who are also working on their own projects rather than solely looking for jobs. I want to meet other creatives who are interested in fostering their communities to bring new voices to entertainment.
answers.inspiration: Donald Glover! It’s always mind blowing to see how much work he put out for free for years before anyone knew who he was. He never let money or a lack of resources stop him from learning to make the things he wanted in every field. He broke a lot of barriers for other young black creators like myself today.
answers.favorite: Nope by Jordan Peele and Beef is my favorite show!
